source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 7 May 1936, p. 15 ("Antrim County Council: nominations for 23 vacancies"); Irish News, 7 May 1936, p. 7 ("Nominations: two new candidates for Slemish; no papers for Ahoghill")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'Nominations for 23 Vacancies' (Belfast News-Letter, 7 May 1936, p. 15); asterisks as printed mark retiring members. The 23rd division, Ahoghill, returned no nomination and its retiring member retained the seat.

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 6 May 1936, withdrawals to 13 May, poll on Thursday 4 June 1936. Only Slemish was contested, and the result was declared on 5 June and reported on 6 June (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1936, p. 7); polling in the local elections took place on 4 June ('Polling takes place to-day', Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1936, p. 11). No party labels were printed. Returned unopposed.
